name: testimonial
title: Testimonial
description: One customer's words in the website's double rule: the tag, the quote in Faculty Glyphic, centred and balanced, then who said it: the company's square initial, the role and the company.
use_for: One quote on a home or product page, from a customer who agreed to it.
never: An invented person: attribute a quote to a role at the company
source: No equivalent in conare-web; set from the website's rules: the FAQ's double rule (Faq.vue), the section tag (Tag.vue), Faculty Glyphic for display text, the square avatar (AccountMenu.vue)

examples.name: Site
examples.label: One customer's words
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Testimonial from '@/components/site/Testimonial.vue'
// One customer's words, attributed to a role at the company.
</script>

<template>
  <Testimonial
    quote="Our support agent answers from every ticket and policy we have, and when it is not sure, it says where it looked."
    role="Head of support"
    company="Acme"
  />
</template>
